mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM metadata_snapshot WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}
AND UPPER(datasource_code) = UPPER(#{datasourceCode})
AND UPPER(object_type) = UPPER(#{objectType})
AND UPPER(object_key) = UPPER(#{objectKey})
AND UPPER(freshness_status) = UPPER(#{freshnessStatus})
AND UPPER(sla_status) = UPPER(#{slaStatus})
AND UPPER(queryability_status) = UPPER(#{queryabilityStatus})
AND UPPER(evidence_status) = UPPER(#{evidenceStatus})
ORDER BY snapshot_time DESC, object_key ASC
